title: Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply - Edit

ancestors.title: Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply

storage.value:
User Story

 

As a system user

I want to be able to update Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply's data

So that I will have possibility to correct my mistake

 

Design: Cancellation_Of_Disconnection)Of_The_Power (adobe.com)

Acceptance criteria:

  1. Check system user permissions to see edit icon on Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply's listing/detail page. If no such permission, edit icon will be disabled

    1. Edit Draft Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply

      1. Allows to edit all Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supplies' objects with status Draft

    2. Edit Executed Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply

      1. Allows to edit all Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supplies' objects with status Executed

  2. Clicking on an edit icon on listing/detail page will allow edit mode

  3. All fields are editable with the regular flow if status is Draft

  4. For Execute objects it is possible to edit only:

    1. Files - to be able to upload new files or to delete manually uploaded files

  5. When Draft object is opened for Editing the table with PODs should be updated. The system should re-evaluate remaining unpaid amounts and preselect PODs using the same rules as on Create, including Liability amount from on the linked Request for disconnection of the power supply.

  6. When Executed object is opened for editing only selected PODs should be displayed in the table

  7. When Executed object is opened for editing Save and Cancel buttons should be visible

  8. When user has created second Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply object for one Request and its status is Executed, already terminated PODs shouldn't be displayed in the second cancellation object

  9. Task's sub-object should be enable and optional in both flows - when object is Draft or Executed

    1. Clicking on Plus button will open Task' creation page where Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply object should be already set as a sub-object

    2. Separate editing

    3. After creating a Task and clicking on Refresh button, newly created task should be set with the following logic:

      1. Task number-Creation date-Task type

    4. It is possible to click already added record or an arrow and system should open task's page in new browser window

    5. It is possible to remove already added task from the Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply object

  10. 'Save as a draft' button (available only if status is Draft)

    1. Enable if user has such permission

    2. Disabled if user does not have such permission

    3. Clicking on Save as a draft button will check all the validations (frontend and backend)

      1. If all the validations are successful, then system should save

      2. If frontend validations are successful, then system should display an error message with proper field

      3. If an error happens in backend, system should display an error message retrieved from the backend

    4. When object is created as a Draft and it is not executed yes, however, user creates identical Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply object, should display all PODs

  11. Save and Execute button (available only is status is Draft)

    1. Enable is user has such permission

    2. Disabled if user does not have such permission

    3. Clicking on Save and execute button will check all the validations (frontend and backend)

      1. If all the validations are successful, then system should save changes and change status to Executed

      2. If frontend validations are not successful, system should display an error message with proper field

      3. If an error happens in backend, system should display an error message retrieved from the backend

  12. System should generate documents according selected templates and save them in Files

  13. System should cancel all generated form this Disconnection taxes for which in the nomenclature Taxes for the grid operator the checkbox Remove tax in Cancelation is marked

  14. ‘Save’ button (available only if status is Executed)

    1. Enable if user has such permission

    2. Disabled if user does not have such permission

    3. Clicking on Save button will check all the validations (frontend and backend)

      1. If frontend validations are not successful, system should display an error message with proper field

      2. If an error happens in backend, system should display an error message retrieved from the backend

  15. When clicking on 'Cancel' or 'X' button should check changes and if there are changes made then warning pop-up message comes out with buttons: 'Your changes are not saved, are you sure you want to cancel?' Yes/No

    1. Yes - will close Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply's editing page and return to listing page

    2. No - will close warning pop-up and stay on Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply's editing page

    3. Warning message should be managed from the system settings

  16. Audit Log record should be created

Customer feedbacks:

https://oppa-support.atlassian.net/browse/PDT-3042
